rooms.name: River of Lost Souls
rooms.desc:
To the west, you can see a blue shimmering light.   To the east, you 
can see a dark tunnel.  The north and south are blocked by tall mountains.

extras.desc:
The light shimmers and dances before your eyes.  It seems magical in
some way!

rooms.name: River of Lost Souls
rooms.desc:
You encounter some rapids as you enter this tunnel cut out of
the mountains by the river.

rooms.name: A long tunnel
rooms.desc: The tunnel branches off north.

rooms.name: A long tunnel
rooms.desc: The tunnel branches off south.

rooms.name: A long tunnel
rooms.desc: The tunnel branches off to the south.

rooms.name: An underground lake
rooms.desc:
You are floating on a jet-black underground lake fed by dripping
water and lime from above. The tunnel continues to the east and the river
leads back west. To the north is a roughly-hewn hallway.

rooms.name: A long narrow tunnel
rooms.desc: The tunnel rises sharply to the east.

rooms.name: A wide tunnel
rooms.desc:
The tunnel continues east and west. To the east the tunnel dives
down into a bright light.

rooms.name: Cave-in
rooms.desc:
You stand at the edge of a large pile of rubble created from the last
rockslide.

exits.desc: You can easily slide down the rocks without getting hurt.

rooms.name: At the foot of the rubble
rooms.desc:
You are at the bottom of a large pile of rubble. A tunnel branches
off to the north and east.

rooms.name: Cave entrance
rooms.desc:
You stand in the middle of a large and beautiful cave. A path leads
deeper into the darkness.

exits.desc: You look down into the cave. Bones are strewn about everywhere.

rooms.name: Giant cave
rooms.desc:
This cavern overwhelms you. The walls and ceiling seem miles away.
Bones of previous adventurers lie strewn on the cavern floor.

rooms.name: Narrow bend
rooms.desc: The tunnel turns to the south and west.

rooms.name: Large cave
rooms.desc: You are standing in a large cave. Many furs are spread out on the floor.

rooms.name: Damp hallway
rooms.desc: The walls here are extremely damp, as well as the floor.

exits.desc: You hear drops of water.

rooms.name: Underground pool
rooms.desc: You are wading in a knee deep pool of lime-water.

rooms.name: Damp hallway
rooms.desc:
The walls of the tunnel are extremely damp here. You hear the faint 
sound of running water to the south.

exits.desc: You hear drops of water.

rooms.name: Narrow crawlway
rooms.desc:
This crawlway is just big enough for a human to crawl through or a
halfling to walk through.

exits.desc: You smell the fragrant odor of fungus.

rooms.name: Large cavern
rooms.desc:
You have entered a very large cavern. The rock formations would amaze
almost any dwarf.

rooms.name: Fungus patch
rooms.desc:
As you walk through the fungus patch, you are shot at by many millions of
spores. You can hardly breathe.

exits.desc: The fragrant smell of fungus spores continues to the east

rooms.name: Fungus path
rooms.desc:
As you walk along the path, millions of spores are shot at you. You can
hardly breathe.

exits.desc: A giant mushroom temple stands to the south.
The fragrant smell of spores continues to the west.

rooms.name: Fungus temple
rooms.desc:
You find yourself standing inside of a giant mushroom. The inside
is decorated in the fashion of a temple.

rooms.name: Sloping passage
rooms.desc: You follow a path sloping down from the fungus temple.

rooms.name: Sloping passage
rooms.desc: You are on a path that gently slopes up from the underground pool.

exits.desc: You hear sounds of trickling water.

rooms.name: The Great Eastern Desert
rooms.desc:
A vast desert stretches for miles, the sand constantly shifting around
you. A pyramid lies to the east and a snow-capped mountain range to the 
west.

rooms.name: A nomad camp
rooms.desc:
This small group of desert nomads has stopped for the day to rest
and refresh themselves beside this beautiful oasis. Three tents and some
camels make up the party. From within two of the tents you hear muffled
voices, obviously surprised at your visit.

exits.desc: Some camels are tied up to a mass of stakes plugged into the ground.
You see inside one of the tents a huddled mass of people, probably slaves.
Sand as far as the eye can see.
Sand as far as the eye can see.

rooms.name: Inside a small tent
rooms.desc:
This is a small and simple tent with few possessions in sight. Lying
here and there are young-looking men and women, possibly slaves to the
leader of this band.

exits.desc: You see the center of the nomad camp.

rooms.name: Beside the camels
rooms.desc:
Here stand about ten camels, all hitched to some stakes plugged into 
the ground. To the east you see a small tent while to the north you see a 
larger, fancier tent.

exits.desc:
This tent seems to be the temporary abode of the nomad leader. You make a
mental note to visit it before you leave.
In this tent there are very large men, all carrying weapons.
You see the center of the nomad camp.
Sand as far as the eye can see.

rooms.name: The warrior's tent.
rooms.desc:
This tent has a few furnishings, but mainly it holds the band's 
protectors. They all stare at you coldly as you enter.

exits.desc: Outside you see some peaceful camels.

rooms.name: The main tent
rooms.desc:
This tent is as lavishly decorated on the inside as it is on the
outside. A fancy carpet lies on the sand and numerous baskets line the
walls.

exits.desc: You see some peaceful camels.

rooms.name: The main tent
rooms.desc:
This is where the leader of this band of nomads resides. He is 
definitely rich as you inspect the tapestries, baskets, and a few
paintings as well.

exits.desc: You see the entrance to this tent.

rooms.name: The rickety rope bridge.
rooms.desc:
You carefully begin across the bridge, but strong gusts of wind
buffet you.  Might be a wise idea to leave.

rooms.name: The wind-swept ledge
rooms.desc:
Being very careful not to lose your balance, you look around and
find that this canyon is about a half a kilometer deep. To the west is
a dark cave leading under the desert sands and above you a rope bridge
spans the gap.

exits.desc: The desert sands blow down in your face.

rooms.name: The cavemouth
rooms.desc:
The air in here is MUCH cooler than outside. From the west you hear 
strange sounds, but can see nothing. The cave slopes down into the 
darkness.

exits.desc: Outside is lighter and very windy.

rooms.name: The mysterious lair.
rooms.desc:
You have stumbled upon the home of something. From the treasure
haphazardly strewn about and the rotting carcases, you would guess that
this is a dragon's lair. As to what type, you can't really say. The cave
narrows out into a tunnel to the west.

rooms.name: A wide tunnel
rooms.desc:
This tunnel seems to go on forever into the darkness. You carefully
feel your way along the walls.

rooms.name: A narrower tunnel
rooms.desc:
The tunnel becomes very narrow and you fight to squeeze your way through.
The floor seems to level off a little.

rooms.name: A narrow crack
rooms.desc:
This part of the tunnel is the hardest to move through as the walls
move in to meet you.

rooms.name: A small cavern.
rooms.desc:
It is dark and damp and bats hang from the ceiling. A narrow crack is
in the east wall. The floor now slopes upwards.

rooms.name: A small shaft
rooms.desc:
From within this shaft you can see a narrow hole in the roof just
large enough for one person. Back east is the cavern.

rooms.name: Smashed Against the Rocks
rooms.desc:
Suddenly, a gust of wind arises out of nowhere!  You attempt to maintain
your control, but the wind is too much.  Ack, your losing it...
You fall...
         ...and fall
                  ...and fall
                           ...and are slammed to death on the rocks.

5000.name: The dervish
5000.long: The raggedy dervish walks on aimlessly.
5000.desc:
Dressed in loose fitting rags, this man looks like he could use
some rest.

5001.name: The dervish
5001.long: The large dervish watches for signs of trouble.
5001.desc:
Dressed in loose fitting rags, this man looks like he could use
LOTS of rest.

5002.name: The coral snake
5002.long: A brightly colored snake slithers along the sands.
5002.desc:
This relatively harmless snake has bright alternating bands of red, yellow
and black.

5003.name: The small scorpion
5003.long: A small, red scorpion scuttles away at your approach.
5003.desc: The little tail is mighty dangerous for such a small creature.

5004.name: The giant, purple sand worm
5004.long: A giant, purple sand worm thrusts up out of the sand and attacks!
5004.desc: He's EXTREMELY big, mean, and purple. Watch out!

5005.name: The brass dragon
5005.long: A very large brass dragon steps out of the darkness and says "Hello".
5005.desc:
This is a very large lizard like creature.  It's burnished brass scales
gleam in the light from your torch.

5006.name: The nomad leader
5006.long: The nomad leader sits silently in prayer.
5006.desc:
He is clad in silk robes lined with gold thread. At his side
is a large, engraved cutlass. He has an especially haughty air
about him.

5007.name: The nomad commander
5007.long: The nomad commander stands here staring suspiciously at you.
5007.desc:
This is the nomad leader's second in command. His clothes are richly
woven of silk and gold thread. A nasty cutlass hangs at his side.

5008.name: The nomad warrior
5008.long: A proud nomad warrior stands here.

5009.name: The slave
5009.long: A young slave sits here staring at you with pleading eyes.

5010.name: The dracolich
5010.long: A pile of bones rises up to form a skeletal dracolich.
5010.desc:
The dracolich is now only bone with pieces of flesh hanging from it.
Obviously it no longer fears death.

5011.name: The drider
5011.long: The drider looks at you with anger while it draws its sword.
5011.desc: This half-spider, half-drow creature is a formidable opponent.

5012.name: The dark dwarf
5012.long: A duergar is here mining precious stones with his pick.
5012.desc: The duergar could crush your head as easily as it does those rocks.

5013.name: The myconoid
5013.desc:
The myconoid looks something like a giant mushroom (and probably
has the same effect).

5014.name: The myconoid shaman
5014.long: A rather large myconoid stands here chanting in a strange tongue.
5014.desc: The shaman shoots spores into the air.

5015.name: The dustdigger
5015.long: A small oasis invites you to dive in.

5017.name: The rabid camel
5017.long: A very dangerous rabid camel snorts at you.

5020.name: The sand worm
5020.long: The young sand worm launches out of the sand to attack you!
5020.desc:
It is about 50 feet long, and looks very dangerous.  Better
flee!
